annotations.title: Is this domain set up safely?

description: A domain's security setup, for anyone launching or running a site or checking a vendor's: can someone send email as it (SPF, DMARC policy, DKIM at common selectors, MX), DNSSEC, CAA, HTTPS (answers, http redirects to https, HSTS), its newest certificate's issuer and days left (certificate transparency), when the registration expires, and security.txt. Verdict: problems, warnings or good, with each finding and how to fix the main ones. Use for 'is my domain set up right?', 'can someone spoof email from X?', 'when does my cert expire?'.
name: domain_check
